result:
Both findings are closed in PR #418 (not merged, per Rule 6 — no self-merge):

- **Multi-Language AI Responses**: `resolvePromptTemplate()` now accepts an additive `locale` param that appends a language directive (new `src/lib/ai-response-locale.ts`, 20 languages), wired into VERI Chat and Help AI via the existing `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie. Decoupled from the UI's 2-locale message-catalog list since an LLM needs no catalog to translate its own output.
- **Multi-Modal input types**: `document-extraction-service.ts` now handles PDF (`pdf-parse`), Word `.docx` and PowerPoint `.pptx` (new `extractPptxRawText()` in `officecli-client.ts`, verified live against the vendored binary), and best-effort `.eml` email text — alongside the existing image-vision path. Video was deliberately left out with a documented reason (no rasterization infra exists).

Verified: `tsc`/`eslint` clean, full test suite 1436 pass/0 fail (including 3 new real-integration test files), `bun run build` succeeds. Claim registered in `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` and PROGRESS.md updated throughout.
